info.title: modelrouter API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible LLM routing proxy with admin APIs for configuration, health, limits, metrics, and usage logging.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Management and observability endpoints. Use admin.token or admin.keys[] Bearer tokens.

get.description: Returns configured public model names. When client auth is enabled, the list is filtered by the caller's access group.

post.description: Routes an OpenAI-compatible chat completion request by the public model name. The request body is passed through to the selected upstream with only model and optional stream_options.include_usage rewriting.

200.description: Upstream chat completion response. For stream requests, the response is text/event-stream.

post.description: Routes an OpenAI-compatible embeddings request by the public model name. The request body is passed through to the selected upstream with model rewriting.

get.description: Requires config:read or admin:read. Secret fields are redacted in the response.

put.description: Requires config:write or admin:write. This updates in-memory config only and does not write back to the config file.

post.description: Requires config:write or admin:write. Reloads from the startup config path.

get.description: Requires admin:read. Returns summary metrics, recent windows, endpoint health, and client limit status.
Requires metrics:read or admin:read. Returns per client/model/route_group/endpoint counters.
Requires metrics:read or admin:read. Reads local usage_log JSONL files and returns matching records with latest records first.
Requires metrics:read or admin:read. Returns recent usage records from local usage_log JSONL files.
Requires metrics:read or admin:read. Aggregates local usage_log JSONL records for charting.

ClientBearerAuth.description: Client API token from auth.keys[].key. Required when auth.enabled is true.

AdminBearerAuth.description: Admin token from admin.token or admin.keys[].key.

Top.name: top
Top.description: Maximum number of breakdown items per dimension.

OpenAIUnauthorized.description: Invalid or missing client API key.

model.description: Public model name configured in models.
Public model name configured in models.

input.description: Input text, token array, or batch input accepted by the upstream OpenAI-compatible provider.

token.description: Full-permission admin token. Redacted as ******** in GET /admin/config.

key.description: Admin bearer token. Redacted as ******** in GET /admin/config.

api_key.description: Upstream API key. Redacted as ******** in GET /admin/config.

headers.description: Fixed request headers sent to this upstream endpoint. If both headers.Authorization and api_key are set, api_key controls Authorization.
